message.content:
Below are a few public APIs that can return company‑level data (including contact information) when you query them with an IP address.  
All of them expose a simple HTTP endpoint that you can hit from any language (Python, JavaScript, curl, etc.).  
I’ll list the service, the key fields you’ll get back, and a quick example of how to call it.

| Service | Key fields returned | Free tier / limits | Example call |
|---------|---------------------|--------------------|--------------|
| **ipdata.co** | `company.name`, `company.domain`, `company.phone`, `company.address`, `company.city`, `company.state`, `company.country`, `company.postal_code`, `company.latitude`, `company.longitude` | 1000 requests/day (free) | `https://api.ipdata.co/<IP>?api-key=<YOUR_KEY>` |
| **ipapi.co** | `org`, `company`, `domain`, `phone`, `address`, `city`, `region`, `country`, `postal` | 1000 requests/day (free) | `https://ipapi.co/<IP>/json/` |
| **ipinfo.io** | `org`, `hostname`, `company` (via paid plan) | 50k requests/month (free) | `https://ipinfo.io/<IP>/json?token=<YOUR_TOKEN>` |
| **ipgeolocation.io** | `company.name`, `company.domain`, `company.phone`, `company.address`, `company.city`, `company.state`, `company.country`, `company.postal_code` | 1000 requests/day (free) | `https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo?apiKey=<YOUR_KEY>&ip=<IP>` |

---

## 1. ipdata.co

**Endpoint**  
```
GET https://api.ipdata.co/<IP>?api-key=<YOUR_KEY>
```

**Response (excerpt)**  
```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "company": {
    "name": "Google LLC",
    "domain": "google.com",
    "phone": "+1 650-253-0000",
    "address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway",
    "city": "Mountain View",
    "state": "CA",
    "country": "US",
    "postal_code": "94043",
    "latitude": 37.422,
    "longitude": -122.084
  }
}
```

**Python example**  
```python
import requests

ip = "8.8.8.8"
api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY"

url = f"https://api.ipdata.co/{ip}"
params = {"api-key": api_key}

resp = requests.get(url, params=params)
data = resp.json()
print(data["company"])
```

---

## 2. ipapi.co

**Endpoint**  
```
GET https://ipapi.co/<IP>/json/
```

**Response (excerpt)**  
```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "org": "AS15169 Google LLC",
  "company": "Google LLC",
  "domain": "google.com",
  "phone": "+1 650-253-0000",
  "address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway",
  "city": "Mountain View",
  "region": "California",
  "country": "US",
  "postal": "94043"
}
```

**JavaScript (fetch) example**  
```js
const ip = "8.8.8.8";
fetch(`https://ipapi.co/${ip}/json/`)
  .then(r => r.json())
  .then(data => console.log(data.company));
```

---

## 3. ipinfo.io

**Endpoint**  
```
GET https://ipinfo.io/<IP>/json?token=<YOUR_TOKEN>
```

**Response (excerpt)**  
```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "hostname": "dns.google",
  "org": "AS15169 Google LLC",
  "company": {
    "name": "Google LLC",
    "domain": "google.com",
    "phone": "+1 650-253-0000",
    "address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway",
    "city": "Mountain View",
    "region": "California",
    "country": "US",
    "postal": "94043"
  }
}
```

**curl example**  
```bash
curl "https://ipinfo.io/8.8.8.8/json?token=YOUR_TOKEN"
```

---

## 4. ipgeolocation.io

**Endpoint**  
```
GET https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo?apiKey=<YOUR_KEY>&ip=<IP>
```

**Response (excerpt)**  
```json
{
  "ip": "8.8.8.8",
  "company": {
    "name": "Google LLC",
    "domain": "google.com",
    "phone": "+1 650-253-0000",
    "address": "1600 Amphitheatre Parkway",
    "city": "Mountain View",
    "state": "CA",
    "country": "US",
    "postal_code": "94043"
  }
}
```

**Python example**  
```python
import requests

ip = "8.8.8.8"
api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY"

url = "https://api.ipgeolocation.io/ipgeo"
params = {"apiKey": api_key, "ip": ip}

resp = requests.get(url, params=params)
data = resp.json()
print(data["company"])
```

---

### Choosing the right one

| Criteria | ipdata.co | ipapi.co | ipinfo.io | ipgeolocation.io |
|----------|-----------|----------|-----------|------------------|
| Free tier | 1000/day | 1000/day | 50k/month | 1000/day |
| Company fields | Yes | Yes | Yes (paid) | Yes |
| Rate limit | 1000/day | 1000/day | 50k/month | 1000/day |
| Pricing (after free) | $0.01 per request | $0.01 per request | $0.01 per request | $0.01 per request |

All of them return the same core data (company name, domain, phone, address, etc.), so pick the one that best fits your usage pattern and budget.  

Happy coding!
